title: Party list 5
note: Every sentence, key word and mishear here was written fresh for Booth Camp (docs/CHAPTER5.md Appendix A): everyday, low-context sentences of 6-9 words with five key words each, in a fixed order. None copies or paraphrases a published sentence test (HINT, BKB, IEEE/Harvard, QuickSIN, WIN, BKB-SIN, SPIN, AzBio): no sentence, list, order or recording. core/tests/test_speech_sin.gd checks the structure and that no sentence repeats. Mishears: one group per key word, the first a sound-alike, a second often a plural or tense trap; none is a homophone of its key word.

items.text: The queen dropped her golden spoon in the pond.
Our neighbour polishes his green helmet every Thursday.
Two pink birds sat on the postbox all morning.
My sister painted the tall door silver.
The frog slept quietly beside the orange bucket.
Tomorrow we meet at the old city library.
